jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior TA Operations Specialist, you’ll own the dashboards and recurring reporting that recruiters and leaders use to make hiring decisions at GitLab. You’ll define how Talent Acquisition (TA) measures hiring, use artificial intelligence (AI) to automate reporting work, and turn findings into recommendations. You’ll also own the systems recruiters rely on and lead operations initiatives from defining the problem through rollout, adoption, and measurement.

What You’ll Do

- Own TA dashboards, from defining recruiting metrics to building and maintaining reports. Check that the same metrics use consistent definitions and match across dashboards and recurring reports.

- Deliver recurring reports for recruiters, TA leaders, and executives on pipeline health, conversion between hiring stages, time to hire, sourcing effectiveness, and progress against the hiring plan. Recommend changes and track which recommendations lead to action.

- Use AI to automate data preparation, flag unusual changes, and draft written analysis so reports explain the numbers. Track the time it takes to prepare each recurring report to see whether automation saves time.

- Lead TA Operations initiatives from business case and stakeholder agreement through design, build, and rollout. Define success before launch, track adoption and results, and revise or retire solutions that don’t deliver.

- Configure GitLab’s recruiting tools, including hiring stages, fields, picklists, scorecards, user access, and permissions in the applicant tracking system (ATS). Own the integrations, lead incident response, and track failures and time to restore service.

- Build and deploy AI agents and automated workflows for recruiting and reporting. Refine prompts, manage models, and track how often agents complete the tasks they’re designed to handle.

- Build business cases for investing in AI and reporting tools using adoption data. Track usage after rollout to see whether the tools are being adopted as expected.

- Own TA’s AI governance framework. Track which AI workflows have completed bias audits, fairness reviews, and privacy compliance checks.

What You’ll Bring

- Experience in recruiting operations, human resources technology, or a related field.

- Experience building and owning recruiting dashboards for senior stakeholders.

- Ability to extract, validate, and visualize data, then explain what it means for hiring decisions.

- Experience using AI to speed up reporting and analysis.

- A track record of leading initiatives from problem definition to launch and adoption.

- Experience configuring and owning an enterprise ATS and its integrations.

- Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents or automated workflows.

We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience. Many successful candidates don’t meet every requirement.

About the team

In Talent Acquisition Operations, we support the systems, reporting, and workflows GitLab uses to hire. You’ll work with our recruiters, TA leaders, and executives to make hiring data easier to act on and bring automation into recruiting workflows with clear standards for fairness and privacy. We work remotely and asynchronously.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$104,800—$176,400 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

- Flexible Paid Time Off

- Team Member Resource Groups

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

- Growth and Development Fund

- Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

About CDP
Custom Data Processing, Inc. (CDP) is a premier provider of data management systems and services for the public health community. Since 1979, we’ve delivered technology that makes a difference, from WIC services and electronic health records to environmental health and data analytics.
Built on family values, we operate with integrity. Our diversified mix of solutions gives us a deeper perspective; one we use to understand the whole picture and serve public health professionals across the country.
The Role
As a Retail Support Specialist, you’ll help grocery stores and other WIC retailers accept WIC benefits through our WIC Direct EBT system. You’ll work support tickets from retailers, state agencies and third party processors, help test and certify point-of-sale (POS) systems, and support special projects like WIC online shopping.
What You’ll Do
Support tickets and retailer support
- Work support tickets from retailers, state agencies and WIC online shopping customers, and troubleshoot POS issues until they’re resolved
- Train retailers, answer their questions, provide APL support, and activate or deactivate WIC Direct accounts
- Ensure tickets are resolved based on CDP standards
- Review data and run audits to keep the master retailer list in WIC Direct accurate

POS testing and certification/ validation
- Help test and certify integrated POS systems for new and existing CDP customers
- Load benefits onto test cards so POS providers can run their certification transactions
- Work with store corporate contacts, POS providers, payment processors and state vendor units to keep systems updated, certified and ready for WIC EBT transactions

Special projects
- Support special projects such as WIC online shopping, helping new and existing online retailers get set up and transacting
- Stay with customers as they move from implementation into day-to-day operations, so nothing falls through the cracks

The Ideal Candidate
- You are a natural troubleshooter. When a POS system rejects a transaction, you dig in until you find the root cause, not just a workaround.
- You are organized with a busy ticket queue. You track every open issue, follow up without being asked, and close the loop with retailers and state agencies.
- You are a clear communicator. You can walk a store manager through a fix and explain the same issue to a payment processor’s technical team.
- You are curious about new technology. Projects like WIC online shopping excite you, and you pick up new systems quickly.
- You care about CDP’s mission and the families who rely on WIC to put healthy food on the table.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- 3 years of experience troubleshooting and resolving issues with POS devices.
- Knowledge of POS systems, payment processors and testing methods
- Clear, patient communicator who can adjust their style to the person in front of them, moving between technical and non-technical communication.
- WIC transaction process knowledge, including Federal rules and regulations
- Ability to travel frequently, including overnight stays.

Nice to Have
- Experience working a ticket queue in a help desk or service management tool
- Experience supporting e-commerce or online ordering platforms

Compensation & Benefits
The salary range for this position is $60,000 – $72,000. Actual compensation within that range is based on factors unique to each candidate during the hiring process. CDP also offers a comprehensive benefits package and meaningful opportunities for growth and advancement within the company.
This is a remote position open and open immediately.
Our Culture
At our core, we value our relationships, both internally and externally. We respect everyone’s contributions: our staff and customers all have a seat at the table. We listen, we comment, and we decide our way forward based on what is best for all.
Our relationships are paramount because they determine our long-term success. When everyone feels empowered, everyone succeeds.
Ready to make an impact?
Apply today through our careers page at cdpehs.com/working-at-cdp

Equal Opportunity Employer

This policy applies to all employment actions, including hiring, promotion, demotion, transfer, recruitment, layoff, termination, compensation, and selection for training. We are committed to maintaining a work environment free of harassment, intimidation, and coercion at all sites and facilities.

jobs.description:
Fruitful is the financial membership that transforms every paycheck into progress—guided by experts and powered by AI automation. Through our proprietary Money Map, Fruitful converts financial advice into a personalized money system that automates someone's entire financial life with a single click—closing the long-standing execution gap in financial planning. Members partner with a dedicated CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® who designs and oversees their Money Map, allocating income across bills, spending, savings, and investments, putting their money on autopilot to drive measurable progress.

We're looking for an incredible person to join our Hospitality team and help push Fruitful forward.

Fruitful has the opportunity to be more affordable, accessible, and comprehensive than anyone in the industry, and it starts with a world-class member experience… Ready to help us build it?

Hospitality @ Fruitful

Our Hospitality team goes beyond traditional customer service, offering members exceptional care at every step of their journey. As a Member Support Specialist, you'll be the consistent, knowledgeable voice our members rely on — handling day-to-day support while helping us build the systems, documentation, and processes that will shape how this function grows.

As Member Support Specialist, you will:

- Own the member support queue end-to-end — triaging, responding to, and resolving inbound email inquiries with care and consistency

- Handle phone callbacks from our main support line, returning calls within defined SLA windows

- Manage membership and account inquiries including cancellations, billing questions, banking and account servicing issues

- Identify and escalate issues that require input from our Guidance, Bank / Investing Ops, or Engineering teams

- Contribute to building our internal knowledge base, macro library, and documentation

- Flag recurring issues and help develop solutions so the same problems stop landing in the queue

- Work a set schedule of 9am-6pm PT, four weekdays plus one weekend day. Remote from any time zone; hours are anchored to 9am-6pm PT (e.g., 12-9pm ET). Schedule may change in the future as different needs arise.

Your Background & Values

- 2–3 years of experience in a member-facing, customer-facing, or support role
Strong written communication skills — you write clearly, warmly, and without jargon
A genuine care for the people you're helping, not just closing tickets but actually solving problems
Highly organized and able to manage your own time and priorities in a remote environment
Energized by process and improvement — you notice when something keeps breaking and want to fix it
Comfortable with ambiguity and working somewhere that's still being figured out
Familiarity with a support tool like Zendesk, Intercom, or Freshdesk is a plus
Experience in fintech, banking, or financial services is preferred

Compensation and Benefits

- Competitive compensation package including salary and equity
Flexible, self-directed time-off
Fully remote
Work-from-home setup stipend
401(k) program with company match
Comprehensive health benefits package with a substantial employer subsidy

Fruitful is building a team that seeks to represent the diversity of our member base. We are an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourage applicants from every background and life experience without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Location & Schedule: This position requires the ability to work remotely in Ukraine and regularly work shifts aligned with US business hours (Mon-Fri 4:00pm-3:00 am).

The Technical Onboarding Specialist / Onboarding Technician is responsible for guiding new customers through the setup, configuration, and successful adoption of Nextiva’s platform. This role combines customer support, technical configuration, and product training to ensure a seamless onboarding experience.

Key Responsibilities

- Assist customers with initial account setup via phone and screen share

- Guide customers through login, configuration, and product functionality

- Configure accounts, call flows, and devices with accuracy and attention to detail

- Perform network checks and basic troubleshooting

- Test configurations to ensure successful implementation

- Deliver customer training on features and product usage

- Meet daily productivity and performance metrics (appointments, call handling, completion rates)

- Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with teams such as Sales, Product Support, CRM, and other internal groups to improve the overall customer experience

AI & Future-Focused Responsibilities

- Collaborate with AI-driven onboarding systems by handling escalations or edge cases AI cannot resolve

- Contribute insights to improve AI onboarding agents based on real customer scenarios

Qualifications

- Proficient English (written and verbal communication)

- Experience in a customer-facing or support role

- Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

- Strong communication and active listening skills

- Commitment to delivering amazing customer service

- Attention to detail and time management

- Basic technical aptitude (software support, device setup, networking fundamentals)

Preferred

- Microsoft Office proficiency

- VoIP experience preferred

- Basic networking knowledge

We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. jobs.title: Senior Global Partner Specialist - USA
jobs.summary: Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence.
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

- Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

- Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

- Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

- Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

- The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

- As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

- An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

Job Summary

The Senior Global Partner Specialist owns the growth and commercial performance of Storyblok's global Longtail partner ecosystem, including New, Nurturing, and Emerging partners of all sizes.

This role develops and delivers scalable programs that enable partners, increase partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, and move partners through the lifecycle from onboarding to sustained commercial activity. Operating primarily through one-to-many engagement, automation, self-service, and data-driven segmentation, the role ensures Storyblok can support and grow a broad partner base efficiently. The role also identifies practical opportunities to use AI and emerging technologies to improve partner experience, efficiency, and scale.

The Senior Global Partner Specialist identifies high-potential Longtail partners that are ready to progress into the Focused segment and works cross-functionally to continuously improve Storyblok's global partner growth model.

Essential Job Functions

- Own and continuously improve the global growth strategy and engagement model for New, Nurturing, and Emerging partners.

- Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue across the Longtail partner ecosystem.

- Design and deliver scalable one-to-many programs that support partner activation, enablement, engagement, and commercial growth.

- Manage partner lifecycle communications and campaigns across relevant channels and partner cohorts.

- Use partner data and performance insights to improve segmentation, prioritization, lifecycle progression, and program effectiveness.

- Identify barriers to partner growth and lead cross-functional initiatives to improve the partner experience and commercial outcomes.

- Own the process for identifying, assessing, and recommending high-potential Longtail partners for progression into the Focused segment.

- Collaborate with Partner Management, Sales, Marketing, Partner Enablement, Solutions Engineering, Developer Experience, and Operations to deliver a connected partner journey.

- Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work, improve partner self-service, and scale partner engagement while preserving human involvement for high-value commercial and strategic moments.

- Define and monitor success measures, share insights with Partner Leadership, and continuously optimize programs based on measurable outcomes.

Education and Experience

- 4-5 years of relevant experience in partnerships, channel management, partner growth, partner programs, business development, revenue programs, or a related SaaS environment.

- Demonstrated experience owning complex programs or business initiatives with measurable commercial outcomes.

- Experience managing or influencing a large portfolio of partners, customers, or accounts through scalable programs.

- Strong understanding of SaaS sales cycles, partner ecosystems, and lifecycle or growth programs.

- Strong analytical skills and experience using CRM, PRM, engagement, enablement, and pipeline data to guide decisions.

- Experience working globally and cross-functionally with commercial, marketing, enablement, operational, and technical stakeholders.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently and lead complex initiatives with limited oversight.

Professional Competencies

- Commercial orientation: Connects partner activity to pipeline and revenue and prioritizes work based on business impact.

- Program strategy and management: Translates strategic objectives into scalable programs and leads complex initiatives from concept through optimization.

- One-to-many partner management: Creates relevant partner experiences across a large portfolio without relying on continuous individual account management.

- Lifecycle, segmentation, and prioritization: Uses partner maturity, behavior, capability, and commercial signals to guide engagement and investment.

- Analytical problem solving: Uses qualitative and quantitative insights to diagnose challenges and develop effective solutions.

- Cross-functional leadership: Aligns stakeholders across functions and influences decisions without relying on direct authority.

- Technology and automation mindset: Identifies practical opportunities to use automation, AI, and digital tools to improve partner experience, operational efficiency, and program scalability.

- Autonomy and ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes and makes sound decisions in an evolving, global environment.

Key Success Measures

- Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue from Longtail partners

- Growth in commercially active partners and first and repeat opportunity generation

- Progression across partner lifecycle stages

- Effectiveness of one-to-many partner programs and communications

- Number and quality of partners progressed from Longtail to Focused

- Growth in partner productivity without proportional growth in manual management effort

U.S. Base Salary Range: $97,000 - $132,000

At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure.
MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here.

jobs.title: Outbound Patient Enrollment Specialist (New College Graduate)
jobs.summary: Headquarters: Remote Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease.
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We're hiring an Outbound Patient Enrollment Specialist to conduct outbound outreach to patients referred to Cadence by partner physicians. You will own the outbound patient enrollment conversation from first contact through completed enrollment. This is a high volume, phone based role that requires clear communication and high attention to detail.

Schedule: Standard working hours are Monday through Friday 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM on Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific Time.

What You'll Do

- Clearly communicate program details, benefits, expected outcomes, patient responsibilities, and the value to patients.

- Facilitate virtual patient enrollments and schedule follow-up appointments with the Cadence Care team.

- Build strong rapport and trust with patients, nurturing lasting relationships based on mutual respect and understanding.

- Follow established scripts to meet quality assurance standards, while adapting your communication to connect authentically with patients.

- Maintain a balance between delivering high-quality patient interactions and achieving productivity targets.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What You Need

- Bilingual English/Spanish is preferred.

- 0-2 years of sales or customer service experience.

- Prior experience conducting high-volume outbound or inbound calls is preferred.

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to address concerns and provide patients with the information needed to support informed decisions.

- Ability to maintain strict patient confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and Cadence standards.

- Experience with AI tools (such as Claude and Google Gemini).

Compensation

The anticipated compensation range for this role is $23-$24/hr, which is based on role scope, level, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for incentive compensation as part of the overall total rewards package with an OTE of $67K-$70K. This position is remote and based in the United States. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, internal equity, and applicable law.
Benefits & Perks

- Competitive pay & equity*

- Fully remote

- Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental & vision

- Paid time off

- 401k plan + matching

- Paid parental leave

- Home office stipend

*benefit offerings may vary depending on job profile, job level and worker type

Cadence is committed to equal opportunity and fairness regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, nation of origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, country of citizenship, medical condition, marital or domestic partner status, family status, family care status, military or veteran status or any other basis protected by local, state or federal laws.

A notice to Cadence applicants: Our Talent team only directs candidates to apply through our official careers page at https://www.cadence.care/our-team. Cadence will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. We receive all applications through our website and anyone suggesting otherwise is not with Cadence.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please contact people@cadencerpm.com

Candidate Privacy Notice & SMS Terms

When you apply for a position with Cadence, we may collect and process personal information related to your application and candidacy, including your name, contact information, resume/CV, work history, education, qualifications, interview notes, job preferences, compensation expectations, availability, and any other information you choose to provide during the application process.

We use this information to evaluate your qualifications, communicate with you about your application, schedule interviews, provide updates on your candidacy, maintain recruiting records, and consider you for current or future opportunities.

We may share candidate information with internal hiring teams and trusted service providers that support our recruiting process, including our Applicant Tracking System, Greenhouse, and our text messaging platform, Grayscale by Paylocity, as applicable. These service providers process information on our behalf and in accordance with our instructions.

We retain candidate information for as long as necessary to support our recruiting process, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and maintain appropriate business records.

SMS/Text Messaging Communications

If you provide your mobile phone number and consent to receive text messages, Cadence may contact you by SMS for recruiting-related purposes. These messages may include application status updates, interview scheduling and confirmations, reminders, follow-ups, and offer-related communications.

We do not use recruiting SMS messages for marketing purposes. We do not sell, rent, or share your mobile phone number, SMS opt-in data, or SMS consent with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties, except with service providers that help us deliver recruiting-related SMS communications.

By opting in to receive SMS messages from Cadence, you agree to receive recruiting-related text messages. Message frequency may vary. Message and data rates may applyYou may opt out of SMS messages at any time by replying STOP, STOPALL, OPTOUT, CANCEL, END, QUIT, UNSUBSCRIBE, or REVOKE. jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote US

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About the role

The Chief of Staff to the SVP of Product is the strategic thought partner and proxy to the leader. The role exists to scale the product leadership function: by anchoring on the leveraged people problems most central to the org, by owning the external product narrative end-to-end, and by being on point for strategic bets that need a single accountable owner (ex: AI enablement, special projects).

The end goal is a healthy Product org with pillar leads running independently at high quality, decisions made with less latency, and a clearer story about where Product is going, and why.

What you’ll do

-
Design and run the product leadership team’s rhythms (staff meetings, product reviews, all-teams, offsites): agenda architecture, pre-reads, decision capture, follow-through

-
Co-own the people rhythms with the HRBP across hiring, calibrations, performance, and talent reviews. Surface emergent structural risks (broken hiring funnels, attrition signals, single points of failure) with proactive solutions

-
Partners with Technology Operations function to define and improve processes for roadmap planning, driving prioritization decisions, setting annual OKRs and tracking progress to goals throughout the year

-
Own headcount planning and budget management alongside the Finance and HR Business Partners: annual planning, quarterly reforecasts, hire-prioritization tradeoffs

-
Drive AI retooling and enablement, including running internal AI masterclasses for leadership and natively embedding AI-enabled processes across the function

-
Curate the external product narrative (all-hands, written updates, major external talks): operate as a speechwriter, partnering with PR, comms, and brand

-
Prepare executive briefings and leadership communications, and reduce decision latency across the Product leadership team

-
Run a recurring org health pulse (engagement scores, regrettable attrition, leveling drift, manager effectiveness), escalating early signals before they become structural problems

What you’ll bring

-
10+ years in roles that built product credibility and strategic-narrative chops: strategy with deep product partnership, or a prior CoS role to a senior product or engineering executive at a high-growth tech company

-
A track record of running people processes at scale (hiring, calibrations, leveling, talent reviews) in a fast-growing organization

-
Exceptional written communication: you can ghostwrite, synthesize narrative from raw inputs, and draft a board page that holds up under scrutiny

-
Pattern-matching for organizational dysfunction: the muscle to spot a broken hiring funnel, a single point of failure, or a leadership gap before anyone names it

-
Comfort operating with influence and without authority across senior leaders in Product, Engineering, Design, Revenue, Finance, and HR

-
Strong analytical foundation and business acumen: fluent enough in product metrics, financials, and growth analytics to reason about tradeoffs without delegating every quantitative question

Why this role matters

Affirm’s next phase of growth depends on Product moving from a function powered by heroics to a function powered by a world-class operating system. The Chief of Staff is the linchpin of the strategic side of that change: the partner who helps make the strategy clear, the org stronger, and the leader’s leverage real.

Base Pay Grade - S

Equity Grade - USA11

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $255,000 - $335,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $226,000 - $306,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

- Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

- Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

- Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

- Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

- Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs

- Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

- Over $300 million raised in funding

- 3,000 Tideans globally

- We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About the team

The Paid Plans Support Team at Tide provides top-tier phone support to paid members, fostering relationships and driving revenue. We prioritize customer needs, embrace challenges, and uphold high ethical standards. We seek proactive, reliable individuals who take ownership, demonstrate high energy, and contribute to our award-winning customer service.

About the role

As a Member Support Smart Associate you’ll be:

- Communicating daily with customers mainly over the phone.

- Providing first-class support over chat and email based on capacity and voice volume;

- Following established procedures and guidelines, but also participate in creating new processes or improving the existing ones;

- Delivering a 5-star customer experience based on a set of pre-defined metrics (Customer Satisfaction, Volume Contribution, Quality Assurance);

- Getting to grips with tough banking challenges like unfamiliar transactions, missing payments, direct debits and other;

- Helping mentor new members of the team, and support them with your wisdom and experience and help out with common back office tasks;

- Monitoring the usage and identifying new opportunities based on customer feedback, segmentation, personas, and user research as well as on the pulse for what's happening in the industry;

- Going through multiple tailor-made trainings and courses to help you elevate your skills and knowledge and make the next step in your career with Tide;

- Working on shifts (weekends and holidays included), based on a schedule that takes into account your preferences, but also meets the needs of the business.

What we are looking for

- You are comfortable talking to customers on the phone and have experience liaising with and responding to member queries (however difficult). A customer-focused mindset is a must!

- You have a minimum of 1.5 years of relevant experience as a phone customer support associate

- You have a very good verbal and written German and English language skills

- You are comfortable using industry tools like Kustomer, GSuite, Microsoft Office and Jira

- You are upbeat and energetic, with solid problem-solving skills

- You have robust communication with the customer and back to the business

- You can demonstrate the ability to self-drive and multitask, your role may vary day to day, as well as strong team collaboration skills, high ethics and morale

It would be considered as an asset if you have:

- Experience in Fin-tech, a start-up or a fast-growing tech company

- Experience working in subscription and/or app-based business models

- Experience with membership programmes

- Analytics knowledge to understand member plan usage and optimisation

What you’ll get in return:

- 25 days paid annual leave

- 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities

- Personal L&D budget

- Additional health & dental insurance

- Mental wellbeing platform

- Fully covered Multisports card

- Food vouchers

- Snacks, light food, drinks in the office

- WFH equipment allowance

- Flexible working from home

- Sabbatical Leave

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

- All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.

- Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.

- Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

We’re approaching ‘Legal Risk’ in Financial Services in a new way.

- We are ready to serve everyone, if we wanted to - we ensure Legal Risk does not constrain the business but empowers it to achieve its goals;

- We create the best possible customer experience - we want our customers (both internal and external) to look forward to going through our processes; and

- We aim to automate everything we do - we don’t like inefficiencies nor do we believe that real risk mitigation is achieved by throwing people at the problem.

The Legal Team is at the forefront of GoCardless’ expansion. We must ensure that GoCardless adopts, implements and maintains forward-thinking and appropriate processes and controls, often coming across new challenges or issues that require innovative solutions.

The role

- You will be an integral part of a collaborative and rapidly growing legal team at a fast-paced fintech scale-up. As a member of a busy legal team you will also contribute to team-wide initiatives and work with people from across our geos and get to learn a lot of new skills along the way.

- Being the first port of call for a broad range of paralegal tasks from all business functions of a high-growth fintech scale-up

- Managing the inflow of legal matters by answering basic queries from across the business and involving other members of the legal team as appropriate

- Administrative tasks that require precision and quick thinking – triaging tickets, helping with setting up documents for signatures and other tasks that leave a big impact

- Assisting with building out and maintaining self-help tools, playbooks and guides for the legal team and for the wider business

- Helping members of the team with ad-hoc projects such as legal research, product launches, corporate projects and IP matters

- An opportunity to work in a global team spanning different countries

Desired skills

- You have experience working as a Paralegal in a leading commercial law firm or in-house

- You have a good understanding of the legal principles as well as the local law, experience in drafting agreements, corporate documents would be considered as an advantage

- You are used to working independently and proactively on a variety of projects simultaneously, and can effectively prioritise, you are not afraid to think out of the box and adopt decisions when needed

- You are easy to work with and are an effective communicator and want to work in a fun, fast-growing but demanding young company

- Learning new things and precision is your second nature, you are tech-savvy and have a sense of how efficiency in processes is driven

Base salary range: 1600 EUR - 2400 EUR (gross).

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point (gross) of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.
(some of) The good stuff

- Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover

- Lunch- based on the location, you either get a meal voucher or a paid lunch when working from the office

- Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 20 working days in any 12-month period

- Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle

- Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure

- Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget

- Time off - generous holiday allowance + volunteer days for ERG events + one day off if you need to move house

Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.

Diversity & Inclusion

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Canada - Remote

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers.

We're hiring Technical Support Specialists to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but build the systems that eliminate them, design how AI handles conversations, and turn customer patterns into product priorities.

You might’ve been the person on a team who builds the dashboards, automations, or workflows that make everyone else better from a Support, Implementation, CS Ops, or Analyst seat. Now you want to formalize that work as the role itself. As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen.

Role and Responsibilities

- Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases. Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter.

- Build and own AI quality. Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain.

- Synthesize and partner with Product/Eng. Produce formal weekly and monthly insights, participate in roadmap conversations with Product Development teams, and mentor Associates on their build and synthesis work.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

- Shipped 3–5 AI solutions

- A monthly drumbeat of synthesized insights that Product and Engineering act on, with visible impact on customer experience or a measurable drop in case volume

- Owns a measurable case-volume reduction in your domain by making cases not happen, not by closing them faster

- You question default workflows instead of just executing them, and you ship more by removing work, not just doing more of it.

- You build with AI to make yourself and the teammates around you faster — automating triage, drafting responses, prototyping internal tools, and turning one-off builds into reusable patterns Associates can run with.

- Mentors Associate teammates on AI builds and pattern synthesis

Professional Qualifications

- 0-4+ years of relevant experience inSupport, Implementation, CS Ops, embedded data analyst, or AI/automation tinkerer in any field.

- A concrete portfolio of things you've built or shipped: prompt-engineered systems, dashboards, automations — with evidence of outcomes

- Strong customer-facing communication and trust-building skills

- Pattern recognition and synthesis muscle

- AI-native default. Reaches for AI tools first, treats ambiguity as the work rather than a blocker, and wants to learn how to configure and supervise these systems — not just use them

- A deep desire to drive results for our customers, with high ownership over the outcomes you own

- Curiosity and natural problem-solving instincts

- An instinct to raise the bar for the teammates around you — teaching others to build and synthesize, not just modeling it yourself

Show us your work

Along with your application, in a cover letter send us:

- 2–3 things you've built or shipped that changed a metric or outcome — what you made, who it was for, why did you need to do it, and what changed.

- A short story about a time your analysis or insight changed a decision someone else made.

Salary range: $52,500 - 75,000 CAD

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Philippines

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b

Position : Bookkeeper / Financial Administrator
Salary : $2000-$3000 NZD
Working Hours & Conditions	: Full time, New Zealand business hours
Holidays : To follow

ABOUT THE COMPANY:
The Company is the world’s largest global franchise network for swimming pool and spa care, operating over 160 retail stores and 600+ mobile service vehicles across New Zealand, Australia, and the United States. Founded in 1992 by entrepreneur John O'Brien, the brand has spent more than 30 years establishing itself as ANZ's (Australia and New Zealand's) leading pool retail and maintenance network.

ROLE OVERVIEW:
The Company is New Zealand's trusted pool and spa service brand, with more than 30 years' experience. It provides pool cleaning and maintenance, equipment inspections, repairs and installation, commercial pool services and a retail range of chemicals, cleaners, filters and pumps.

The business needs a dedicated full-time bookkeeper and financial administrator who takes full ownership of the finance function. The role is focused on bookkeeping and financial administration. Operations, general admin and inbox management are not part of it and stay with the existing team. This person becomes the single owner of the books.

The business runs on three connected systems: Pooltracker for field service and invoicing, Lightspeed for retail point of sale and inventory, and Xero as the final accounting layer. Differences between the systems are common, so the role needs someone with an investigative mindset who enjoys finding where numbers have gone astray.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Day-to-Day Financial Administration (Primary Focus)
- Own bank reconciliations, accounts payable and accounts receivable in Xero
- Prepare GST returns accurately and on time, in line with New Zealand requirements
- Keep the books up to date, accurate and audit-ready
Resolving Discrepancies Between Systems
- Reconcile data across Pooltracker, Lightspeed and Xero, investigating the cause of differences and fixing them at the source
- Check that invoices raised in Pooltracker, sales and stock in Lightspeed and the ledger in Xero all agree
- Document recurring causes and the fixes, so the same discrepancies don't keep returning
Inventory Accounting & Cost of Goods Sold
- Manage inventory accounting between Lightspeed and Xero, including stock movements, adjustments and valuation
- Work with the client to set up reliable cost of goods sold tracking, an area that is not fully resolved yet
- Recommend and document a clear process so inventory and margins can be trusted
Payroll
- Process payroll accurately and on time, in line with New Zealand requirements, including PAYE and KiwiSaver
- Keep payroll records accurate and reconciled to the ledger

Reporting
- Produce monthly profit and loss reporting and management reports
- Report on overdue accounts and follow up outstanding invoices
- Report on upcoming supplier payments so nothing is missed
- Send a clear monthly reconciliation summary that highlights anything unusual

Non-negotiable
- Strong Xero skills and a solid understanding of New Zealand accounting
- Hands-on GST experience
- Experience across bank reconciliations, AP, AR and monthly management reporting
- Experience processing payroll under New Zealand rules
- An analytical, problem-solving approach, with strong attention to detail
- Tech-savvy and quick to learn connected systems
- Availability to work New Zealand business hours
- Clear written English for finance communication with suppliers and the team
Strong Plus
- Experience with Lightspeed (retail POS and inventory)
- Experience with inventory and cost of goods sold accounting for a retail or trade business
- Experience with a field service or job management system (Pooltracker is niche but learnable)
- Experience in a franchise, trades or service business
Soft Skills & Working Style
The manager needs someone who takes ownership of the numbers and tells her what she needs to know before she has to ask.
- Proactive and independent, taking ownership of financial tasks end to end
- Curious and persistent when numbers don't match across systems
- Accurate, organised and reliable, especially around month-end
- Communicates clearly, flagging problems early and summarising things simply
- Discreet and trustworthy with the business's financial information

Headquarters: Indonesia

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/hS1Fg6yA2YGb3vBeEZy9fP/jobs-at-umaez-llc

About US
We are a 7-8 figure direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand portfolio operating across the US and international markets, led by our flagship brand GODA. We build and scale high-demand beauty, fragrance, and personal care products shipped directly to hundreds of thousands of customers. At our scale, customer trust, fast problem resolution, and post-purchase loyalty are everything. When a customer experiences friction, whether a delayed delivery, a subscription billing question, or a public escalation, this role turns a frustrated buyer back into a loyal brand advocate.

The Role
Standard customer support reacts to incoming tickets. As Executive Resolution & Outbound Retention Specialist, you prevent churn and protect brand reputation. Sitting inside our Outbound, Retention & Reputation team, you are the senior voice customers speak with when high-priority issues arise, and the proactive specialist who reaches out by phone and email to recover failed payments, retain subscribers, and grow verified 5-star reviews.

What You'll Be Doing
BBB & High-Priority Escalation Ownership
- 24-Hour SLA Resolution: Monitor, respond to, and resolve incoming BBB complaints and public review escalations within a strict under-24-hour response window.
- Phone-First De-Escalation: Conduct calm, empathetic outbound calls to frustrated US customers, diagnose what went wrong in Shopify/Commslayer, and deliver fair, tailored solutions (express reshipments, Loop exchanges, store credit, or approved refunds).
- Official Portal Closure: Draft clear, non-defensive written responses inside the BBB Business Portal and follow up directly with customers until they confirm satisfaction and close the case.
- Cross-Functional Fulfillment Coordination: Partner directly with our Order Fulfillment team to expedite stuck, delayed, or partially fulfilled orders tied to escalated cases.
Outbound Retention, Payment Recovery & Reputation Growth
- Failed Payment & Win-Back Calls: Execute daily outbound phone calls and tailored email follow-ups to help subscribers update failed payment methods and keep active deliveries running smoothly.
- Subscription Save Outreach: Connect with at-risk or canceling subscribers to understand friction points and offer flexible alternatives (skips, cadence adjustments, or product swaps).
- Trustpilot Review Generation: Reach out to verified happy GODA customers via phone and email to encourage authentic 5-star reviews on Trustpilot and public storefronts.
- Escalated Email Queue: Handle sensitive email threads escalated from Inbound Customer Care involving dispute/chargeback threats, billing misunderstandings, or repeat delivery issues.
Tracking, Compliance & Root-Cause Feedback
- 100% Case Hygiene: Maintain accurate, real-time logs across Commslayer, Shopify, and the BBB resolution tracker so zero open cases fall through the cracks.
- Upstream Prevention: Tag recurring escalation drivers (carrier delays, renewal confusion, SKU defects) and share weekly insights with the CS Manager and Process Experts to fix root causes.

Must-Haves
- Proven Voice + Email Experience: 2+ years in DTC e-commerce customer support, escalations, retention, or account resolution, with strong comfort making daily outbound phone calls and writing tailored escalation emails.
- US-Overlap Availability: Able to work a full-time shift overlapping with US daytime/afternoon hours to reach US customers live by phone.
- Composed, Persuasive Communication: Clear, warm, natural English (spoken and written) with the emotional intelligence to de-escalate upset buyers without sounding scripted or defensive.
- High Follow-Through Discipline: You never mark a case finished until the resolution is confirmed by the customer and properly logged in external portals.
- Tech-Stack Fluency: Hands-on comfort working daily in e-commerce order dashboards, helpdesks, cloud VoIP dialers, and Google Sheets trackers.
Strong Advantages
- Reputation & Dispute Experience: Prior hands-on management of Better Business Bureau (BBB) complaints, Trustpilot outreach, or chargeback/dispute prevention.
- DTC Core Tools: Direct experience with Shopify, Commslayer (or Zendesk/Gorgias), Loop Returns, Aircall/RingCentral, and subscription platforms (Recharge, Skio, or Stay AI).
- Subscription Brand Background: Previous experience supporting a high-volume DTC beauty, fragrance, wellness, or personal care subscription brand.
Instant No's
- Phone Hesitation: You prefer hiding behind email macros rather than picking up the phone to speak directly with an upset customer.
- Copy-Paste Mindset: You rely on rigid policy scripts instead of listening to the customer's actual issue and tailoring the fix.
- Loose Documentation: Forgetting to update trackers or close portal responses. Accurate records protect both the customer and our brand rating.

How We Measure Your Performance- BBB SLA & Closure Rate: 100% first outreach within 24 hours and measurable month-over-month improvement in GODA's BBB resolution rate and profile rating.
- De-Escalation & Retention Save Rate: Percentage of escalations, failed payments, and at-risk subscriptions resolved without chargebacks or churn.
- Outbound Activity Consistency: Daily completion of outbound call and email targets across BBB, payment recovery, and review queues.
- QA & Compliance Score: Consistent adherence to brand voice, pre-approved resolution authority limits, and zero billing/compliance errors.

Hiring Process & Compensation- Competitive base salary based on experience + QA-gated monthly performance bonus tied to retention saves, payment recovery, and escalation resolution.
- 100% remote role inside a structured 7-8 figure DTC Customer Experience organization with clear growth into Senior Anchor, QA, or Team Lead roles.
- Selection Gate: Shortlisted candidates complete a brief 5-minute live phone de-escalation roleplay and a short written BBB response test.

jobs.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

We are looking for a people's person with technical acumen to assist our customers with a range of issues. You'll be providing support across GC products and processes.

As a technical customer support specialist, you will be the first point of contact for any issues on our API, you will be the main point of escalation within the customer support team. You will be talking to engineers, product owners, customer success, partnership managers, solutions engineers, and many more. These people know what they're doing, what they need, and really appreciate sharp, to-the-point support.

You will need to investigate across an array of logs, databases, error monitoring tools. Test and recreate bugs. Consult and improve documentation, collaborate with developers, testers, salespeople and product managers. You will live and breathe customer needs and problems and bring their concerns to the table, be their advocate.

As well as overseeing & future-proofing operational processes and workflows, such as using data analysis and stakeholder management to ensure the successful and scalable onboarding of new customers, handling migrations to and away from GoCardless, and the regular review of opportunities with the upgrades of existing customers.

You’ll also be responsible for the team’s visibility within the business, presenting on wins and pushing for product and feature enhancements in line with opportunities spotted. As well as process future-proofing, you’ll be leading the charge to ensure the team is built in an agile and sustainable way, taking the reins when recruitment drives are needed and developing your team mates.

The cases you will handle via our CS platform (Zendesk) will be very diverse and full of surprises. It will not be a numbers game, but one of quality and creativity. From the various cases that you will handle on a daily basis, half are initially a mystery that requires a good amount of head-scratching and collaboration..

We take pride in the quality of our support and are looking for a professional who will help us take our service to the next level.

What excites you

- Understanding complex systems and processes

- Devising new ways to extract and process data

- Participate in automating your tasks and making your job easier

- Process driven work at varying levels of complexity

- Solving and pre-empting risks by drilling in to the details to ‘crack’ a problem and proactively identifying issues

- Delivering excellent service to our customers and partners

- Pushing for improvement opportunities and working alongside your manager to implement these

- Working cross functionally to ensure the best experience and outcome for our customers as our processes scale and adapt

- Provide support on internal operations and the GoCardless product to colleagues, via internal chats and escalations

- Review and create GoCardless Partner accounts for businesses

- Supporting the company in delivering projects, both internal and external to the Customer Support team.

- Take part in resolving incidents and sending larger comms to impacted customers, where relevant

What excites us

- Experience in customer support, preferably SaaS

- Strong logical and analytical skills

- Tech experience, understanding code. (took a course, dropped out of Computer Science in university, you like to tinker with automations, etc..)

- Emotional intelligence and empathy, passion for helping people

- Resourcefulness, thinking outside of the box and ability to look up information

- You understand the importance of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing

- You're comfortable working with internal stakeholders at all levels, upholding our core product & compliance requirements with a problem-solving approach

- You don’t lose focus and always look for ways to improve - even if the task is repetitive

- You’re a fast learner and not afraid to ask when you don’t know the answer

- You can prioritise multiple tasks and switch between them effortlessly

- You are a problem solver and have the patience to identify discrepancies and root causes - even if it takes time and you have to dig deep

- You like to dive into details to find the right answer and always follow through to the end

- You have excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have

- Experience working with API's , Kibana, SQL, Zendesk, Postman,

Salary range - the expected base salary range for this position is between €1660 - €2500 (gross).

Base salary ranges may vary and are determined by things like geography, level of experience, interview assessment and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, there is no guarantee that an offer will reach the upper limit of the stated range.
(some of) The good stuff

- Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover

- Lunch- based on the location, you either get a meal voucher or a paid lunch when working from the office

- Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 20 working days in any 12-month period

- Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle

- Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure

- Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget

- Time off - generous holiday allowance + volunteer days for ERG events + one day off if you need to move house

Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.

Diversity & Inclusion

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:

Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — 25%

Neurodiverse — 9%

Disabled — 1%

Average age — 33

Female — 45%

Male — 55%

We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.

If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives here

Sustainability

We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability action plan here.

Find out more about Life at GoCardless via Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn.

Headquarters: United States (Remote)

Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

Tines is hiring its first Paralegal to keep Legal running smoothly as we grow globally. Reporting to the Head of Legal, you'll join a lean global Legal team that includes a dedicated Legal Operations role. You'll partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance, Security and teams across the business to get agreements done quickly and soundly. You'll support the full range of our legal work, including commercial, partner, vendor and corporate matters. Working alongside Legal Operations, you'll handle first-pass review of agreements, contract records and obligations tracking. You'll also run the Legal team's day-to-day administration, including calendars, scheduling, travel and invoices.

What You Will Be Doing

- Partnering with Legal Operations on contract intake and prioritization, and taking standard agreements from first review through to signature.

- Doing first-pass review and redlines of customer, partner and vendor agreements, DPAs and security terms against Legal's playbooks and approved fallbacks, and escalating anything outside them to the right Legal Counsel.

- Maintaining the contract repository and key-term data, and tracking renewals, notice periods and contractual obligations.

- Running Legal team administration: coordinating meetings, outside counsel engagement letters and invoices, matter tracking and document filing.

- Keeping templates, playbooks, clause libraries and Sales enablement materials current as our products and practices change.

- Working with Legal Operations to improve Legal workflows and automations, including in Tines itself.

- Supporting broader Legal team projects as needed.

What You Will Bring

- Paralegal certificate or bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.

- 5+ years of legal experience, including 3+ years as a paralegal, ideally supporting commercial, technology or corporate work in-house or at a law firm.

- A strong understanding of the legal issues affecting SaaS and software transactions.

- Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. Experience with DocuSign and Notion is a plus.

- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

- Proven ability to manage many matters at once and meet deadlines.

- Comfort owning administrative work, including calendar management, scheduling, travel and invoices, alongside substantive contract work.

- Alignment with Tines’ values of speed, simplicity, and soundness.

Experience That Would Be Helpful

- Previous in-house experience at a SaaS, software, cybersecurity, or other technology company.

- Experience supporting commercial teams across EMEA and the United States.

- Familiarity with AI products and the commercial, privacy, and intellectual property issues that arise when customers use them.

Target Annual Compensation: $100k - $115k salary + equity
