jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Cette fois ci, Octopus Energy France cherche son/sa futur.e Executive Assistant pour accompagner Céline, notre CEO, et le COMEX dans une phase de forte croissance.
Tu seras le véritable bras droit opérationnel de son bureau : ton rôle est de fluidifier son quotidien et de lui faire gagner de précieuses heures chaque semaine.

-
Piloter l’agenda de Céline et du COMEX de façon proactive : arbitrer, prioriser, protéger les temps de réflexion, anticiper les conflits.

-
Trouver des solutions créatives quand les rendez-vous ne rentrent plus : recomposer, déplacer, condenser, proposer des alternatives.

-
Faire le lien entre l’interne et l’externe : équipes, Groupe UK, partenaires, institutionnels (cabinets ministériels, etc.), dont les plans changent souvent à la dernière minute.

-
Rédiger des emails en français comme en anglais, avec un ton juste selon le destinataire (équipes, Groupe, institutionnels).

-
Organiser les déplacements (France et Europe), les événements et les temps forts (séminaires, ateliers, ....).

-
Traiter des sujets confidentiels (RH, financiers, stratégiques) avec une discrétion et une confidentialité absolues.

-
Tu as minimum 5 ans d’expérience en assistanat de direction (C-level ou COMEX), idéalement en scale-up ou en environnement international dynamique.

-
Tu es bilingue ou courant.e en français et en anglais : tes écrits sont clairs, soignés et sans faute, et tu sais adapter le ton (direct avec les équipes, plus formel avec l’extérieur). Tu échangeras au quotidien avec le Groupe.

-
Tu restes calme quand tout bouge en même temps, et tu sais jongler entre urgences internes et sollicitations externes.

-
Tu es créatif.ve et débrouillard.e : face à un agenda impossible, tu cherches une solution au lieu de remonter le problème.

-
Tu sais décider seul.e sur l’essentiel et reconnaître ce qui doit être remonté.

-
Tu es doté.e d'un excellent relationnel et d'assertivité : tu es à l’aise pour relancer des dirigeants, les challenger et dire « non » avec tact.

-
Éthique et discrétion irréprochables

-
Tu maîtrises Google Workspace et Slack, et tu prends vite en main de nouveaux outils.

- Contrat : CDD 5mois, temps plein (pouvant déboucher sur un CDI)

- Rythme & Lieu : Poste basé à Paris, 100 % au bureau pour être au cœur de l’action et au plus près de Céline et des équipes.

- Démarrage : ASAP.

Collette is seeking a Group Specialists to join our Client Care Center. This is a remote role.
About Collette: Let Us Show You the World
There has never been a better time to be in the travel industry. See the world, connect with others, and experience the immersive benefits of one of the trendiest industries when you join the Collette team! As the longest-running tour operator in North America, our family-owned business leads the industry in innovation and expertise. Collette’s passionate team works hard to fulfill travel dreams and is always looking for talent that will help to shape the company’s future. Being part of the Collette team means having a willingness to grow, a desire to learn and ask questions, and a zest for seeing the world. From giving back to local communities to creating incredible experiences for a world of travelers and being part of a value-oriented team that cares for one another – Collette is all about the people. So, what are you waiting for? Your journey starts here.
Position Summary:
The Group Specialist is responsible for maintaining daily functions as they pertain to multiple Business Development Managers within a specific selling region. You like working with people. You are someone who can delight with promptness, thoroughness, and accuracy This is your chance to join a team dedicated to helping our group leaders and their guests fulfill their dreams of exploring the world! The prime responsibility is to act as a liaison and support existing accounts to maintain and grow revenue to exceed sales objectives of assigned territory
Primary Functions:
- Serve as the primary point of contact for travel professional group client base to meet customer demands and expectations through inbound/outbound calls
- Responsible to drive revenue growth and retention of existing accounts. Responsible for driving sales by analyzing existing bookings, potential upgrades and future travel needs.
- Maximize customer relationships and responsible for ensuring positive interactions at frequent touchpoints while optimizing the customer experience.
- Manage all required touchpoints including promotional calls, deposit due calls, flight schedule calls, hometown pick-up calls and other customer service activities.
- Collaborate closely with the Business Development Managers and cross functionally with multiple internal teams.
- Assist sales relating to existing and/or new orders and actively seek opportunities to close group business.
- Audit account fliers, presentations, documentation parties, air schedules, tour manager requests and sign-ups, adding tours to existing accounts and other marketing needs.
- Manage customer complaints in a professional manner and offer proactive solutions.
- Manage group block audits and loyalty programs.
- Ensure current knowledge of products, processes, policies, and procedures.
Knowledge & Skills:
- Team player - we win as a team
- Able to build constructive and effective relationships, while nurturing them to build an amazing tribe of loyal, excited, passionate fans.
- Demonstrates excellent verbal, written and interpersonal skills. Develops and maintains a high level of expertise in account service /consultative selling techniques, product knowledge, procedures, and administration.
- Knowledge of sales principles: closing skills, negotiation skills, and motivation for sales.
- Demonstrate confidence, a positive attitude and effectively work with others to positively impact level of service.
- Results oriented with proven ability to be flexible, work in a fast-paced environment and take additional responsibilities to meet business need.
- Proficient conflict management skills to include ability to resolve issues in a stressful situation and demonstrating personal resilience
- Self-directed with the ability to think independently
- Ability to manage time and scheduling efficiently
- Willingness to help team members by sharing knowledge
- Strong computer skills are necessary, and a working knowledge of CRM management, Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word is ideal
- Proactively look for ways to improve internal processes
- Flexibility to customize approach to meet all types of member communication styles and personalities
- Willingness to work hard and have fun doing it!
- Bilingual speaking skills a plus
- Bachelor’s Degree Preferred
Compensation & Benefits
We believe in taking care of our team—inside and outside of work.
The pay range for this position is $19.59 - $22.00 per hour.
What We Offer:
- Health & Wellness: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage—plus a Peloton One Membership to keep you moving
- Time Off: Generous PTO, paid holidays, and your birthday!
- Volunteer Time: Paid hours to give back to causes you care about
- Financial Security: 401(k) with company match
- Family Support: Paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave and access to our Employee Assistance Program
- Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement to help you level up your skills
- Exclusive travel discounts, incentives and more!

jobs.description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.

Job Overview
Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.

About us
Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.
We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.
We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.

What you'll do
- Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
- Write video scripts and outlines.
- Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
- Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.

What we're looking for
- Native-level written and spoken English
- Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
- Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
- Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
- AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
- High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
- Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
- Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
- Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
- A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
- Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
- Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada

Nice to have
- Previous experience creating educational video content
- Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
- Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos

Working at Metics Media
At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.
At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.

Compensation
- Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
- Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
- For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.

Benefits
- 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
- 10 paid sick days per year
- Medical, dental, and vision coverage
- A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)

How to apply
Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.summary: Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result.
jobs.description:
Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. Marketing Operations is where that execution lives. This role exists to ensure that every dollar of marketing spend, every campaign, every event, and every account-based program translates into pipeline with zero friction. That requires a system built for precision where the right prospect reaches the right person at the right time, consistently and by design.

You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.

In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high-performing whole.

What You'll Own

- Account-Based Marketing Orchestration: Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest-impact contributions this role makes to the business.

- Marketing Technology Foundation: Own the day-to-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.

- Agentic AI Workflow Engineering: Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.

- Enrichment and Insights: Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first-party behavioral signals, third-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.

- System Documentation and Enablement: Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self-sufficient, building self-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.

Who You Are

You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.

You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. You approach your work with that accountability in mind.

You are technically strong and collaborative by nature. Marketers, Sales and RevOps are close partners. You understand their workflows well enough to anticipate where system gaps will affect their work, and communicate clearly when something is broken, when it is fixed, and why. Strong cross-functional relationships are central to this role.

You see the work through to completion. You build, test, document, and close the loop. When something you own regresses, you identify it first.

What We're Looking For

Required

- 3 to 5 years in B2B SaaS Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a systems-adjacent role

- Hands-on marketing automation and CRM administration, including configuring and maintaining MAP-to-CRM syncs

- Demonstrated ability to build and deploy an automated workflow that calls external APIs, whether webhooks, REST APIs, or LLM endpoints, in a production environment

- Native fluency in B2B funnel mechanics: MQL definitions, lifecycle stage transitions, opportunity lifecycles, and attribution models

- Experience coaching or enabling non-technical stakeholders on new tools, AI workflows, or self-service reporting

Strong Signal

- Hands-on administrative experience with intent data platforms, routing engines, and ABM orchestration

- Prior experience building LLM-powered workflows for lead scoring, routing, or qualification

- Comfort reading and writing JSON, working with REST APIs, and debugging integration errors independently

How We'll Measure Success

The through-line across all of it is pipeline efficiency: more of the right prospects converting into pipeline from the programs already running, with less manual intervention and less fallout.

30 days: Full audit of marketing automation-to-CRM field mapping is complete, ownership of inbound routing rules is established, and current ABM workflow patterns are mapped to identify key automation opportunities.

60 days: First agentic AI workflow is deployed to staging or production. At least one major ABM orchestration sequence that previously required manual steps is automated. An initial self-service enablement resource or dashboard is delivered to the marketing team.

90 days and beyond: Lead sync exception rate is at target with a monitoring process that catches regressions before Sales does. ABM orchestration operates as a reliable service layer that campaign and field marketers can brief and trust to execute. Marketing colleagues actively leverage self-service tools and AI workflows independently.

Application Question

Required with your resume (200 words max):

A high-intent prospect submits a demo request but never reaches the assigned SDR in the CRM. Walk us through your exact diagnostic process: which logs you check first, how you trace the break across the marketing automation-to-CRM sync and inbound routing rules, how you validate the fix, and how you would design an agentic step to evaluate the prospect's form submission notes for priority routing.

Pay Range (OTE Pay): $86,000 - $120,000

Other Types of Pay: Based on level and role the employee may be eligible for long term incentives in the form of equity and short term incentives of either bonus or commission.

Health Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Retirement Benefits: 401(k) plan

Paid Time Off: Talkdesk offers an uncapped paid time off program for exempt employees and an accrual-based program for non-exempt employees; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs.

Paid Holidays: Talkdesk offers 14 paid holidays each year.

Paid Sick Leave: Exempt employees have uncapped paid time off and non-exempt sick leave follows accrual standards; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs.

Method of Application: Apply online.

Application Window: The application window is expected to close at least 10 days from the posting date. The application was posted on 09/25/2026.

Benefits and perks listed above may vary based on the nature of your employment with Talkdesk.

All questions or concerns about this posting should be directed to the Talent team at Talent@talkdesk.com.
Talkdesk is pioneering a new era of Customer Experience Automation (CXA), redefining how the world’s most admired brands interact with their customers through AI. Our global team of courageous innovators is customer-obsessed, building AI-first solutions that put empathy, trust, and transparency at the center of every interaction. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive our success and every voice belongs. Combining the stability of a global leader with the agility of a disruptor, Talkdeskers are empowered with the autonomy to drive meaningful impact, while giving back to the communities and environment around us.

Talkdesk has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and in the G2 Overall Grid® Reports for AI Agents and Contact Center. With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation!

Work Environment and Physical Requirements:

Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.)

The Talkdesk story hinges on empathy and acceptance. It is the shared goal among all Talkdeskers to empower a new kind of customer hero through our innovative software solution, and we firmly believe that the best path to success for our mission is inclusivity, diversity, and genuine acceptance. To that end, we will hire, promote, work along, cheer for, bond with, and warmly welcome into the Talkdesk family all persons without regard to ethnic and racial identity, indigenous heritage, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.summary: Job Summary: The Clinical Training Support Specialist plays a vital supportive role in designing and managing high-quality onboarding and clinical training across the entire Includ…
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
The Clinical Training Support Specialist plays a vital supportive role in designing and managing high-quality onboarding and clinical training across the entire Included Health Clinical Practice/Clinical Org practice—spanning Virtual Care, Population Health, and emerging service lines. Your primary focus will be on instructional design, transforming complex clinical policies and workflows into engaging digital learning content (eLearning modules, video simulations, and interactive scenarios). As a core pillar of the training team, you will manage our Learning Management System (LMS), collect and analyze training data, and act as a dedicated learner assistant to ensure seamless educational rollouts.
While your primary focus is content creation and support, you will also assist in cross-covering live training sessions for various onboarding cohorts. You will be an AI-forward builder who uses AI tools and other technologies to accelerate content development, reduce manual work, and embed just-in-time support into the clinician experience. This role is ideal for an instructional design professional who excels at behind-the-scenes content creation and LMS administration, yet remains flexible enough to step into the room to support live learners and educators when needed.
Responsibilities:
1. Content Creation, Execution & Maintenance
Prepare, use, and update existing training materials (slides, facilitator guides, job aids, scenarios, and exercises) created and/or approved by the Senior Clinical Training Specialists, Manager, and CKE team.
Surface content gaps or inconsistencies you see during training (e.g., slide doesn’t match CRC, workflow screenshot is outdated) so they can be prioritized for formal updates.
Use LMS and training tools at a proficient user level (launching sessions, tracking completions, pulling basic reports).
Design instruction based on clinical workflows in collaboration with CKE team and stakeholders.
2. Cross-Service Line Clinical Facilitation
Deliver live virtual training (group sessions, small-group breakouts, and 1:1 coaching) for clinical new hires and tenured clinicians across Virtual Care and Population Health service lines.
Facilitate a mix of foundational, workflow, and application-based sessions (e.g., documentation practice, care plan workflows, triage scenarios, navigation workflows) using adult learning best practices.
Support or co-lead clinical simulations, mock calls, and role plays, observing performance, giving clear, behavior-based feedback, and escalating clinical safety concerns appropriately.
Flex into different service lines as hiring volume, redesign work, or audit findings shift the training portfolio — maintaining sufficient cross-training to be safe and effective wherever you are deployed.
3. Cohort Support & Learner Coaching
Partner with the Senior Clinical Training Specialists to execute the day-to-day plan for new hire cohorts (agenda, timing, logistics, handoff points).
Monitor learner engagement, participation, and performance during sessions; identify individuals who need additional support and provide targeted coaching or remediation as directed by the Senior(s) and Manager.
Use rubrics, checklists, and competency tools to document learner progress and escalate concerns regarding readiness for independent work.
Contribute to a psychologically safe learning environment where clinicians can practice, make mistakes, and receive direct but supportive feedback.
4. Data, Feedback, and Continuous Improvement
Capture and share learner feedback, questions, and pain points from the classroom in a structured way to inform curriculum improvements and service-line decisions.
Create and monitor formal metrics for learning and successful application of skills.
Use available data (e.g., knowledge checks, simulation scores, survey results) to describe trends you’re seeing in learner performance and experience, and to validate where additional coaching or clarification is needed.
Participate in course audits, pilots, and retrospectives, giving concrete recommendations on pacing, activities, and scaffolding from the trainer perspective.
Champion a “Spirit of Inquiry” by modeling curiosity, evidence-based practice, and openness to feedback in your own facilitation.
5. Surge Support & Operational Flex
During surge periods or large cohorts, act as co-facilitator/producer, managing breakout rooms, chat questions, tech issues, and basic operational workflows so Senior Trainers can focus on high-complexity clinical teaching and stakeholder interactions.
Lead or co-lead baseline operational sessions (e.g., navigation of training environments, structured documentation practice, non-clinical workflows) when appropriate to free up Senior bandwidth.
Adhere to and reinforce capacity rules and surge protocols defined by the Manager and Senior Trainers (e.g., ratio rules, blackout dates, backup facilitator coverage).
Required Qualifications:
Experience:
2+ years of experience in formal clinical/healthcare training, precepting, clinical education, or adult learning.
Specifically, instructional design, LMS management, data collection, learner assistance, etc.
Facilitation & communication:
Strong virtual facilitation skills (Zoom/Google Meet or similar).
Demonstrated ability to explain complex clinical workflows in clear, practical language and to give direct, respectful feedback to peers or learners.

Comfortable flexing between service lines, cohorts, and workstreams as priorities change.
Proven ability to build trust with clinicians, people leaders, and cross-functional partners.

About the brand
Haven manages cabins and mountain homes in the Great Smoky Mountains and around Knoxville, Tennessee. Steep driveways, hot tubs, wood stoves, and a season that swings from quiet weeks to a full house every weekend. It is a market where property care is guest experience: a cold hot tub is a ruined anniversary, and a turnover that runs late is a family waiting in the driveway.
The role
You are the person who makes sure every cabin is guest-ready before the next family arrives. You are the main communication point between Haven operations and our Tendwell cleaning teams. Your day starts with the departures, arrivals and cleaning schedule, and from there you follow up with cleaners on progress and ETAs, clear whatever is blocking a turn, coordinate re-cleans and supply fixes, and confirm each home is ready before a same-day check-in.
When a guest checks out late, you work out what it does to the cleaning schedule and tell operations what timing is realistic. It is a role for someone who is highly responsive and calm under same-day pressure. Asking for an update is not the same as getting the home ready. If a turn is yours, you own it until it is confirmed complete.
Where you sit
You sit in Housekeeping & Field Ops and work every day with Tendwell cleaners and Haven’s operations team. This is not a role where you are handed a queue and left alone.
This role is remote and based in LATAM, covering U.S. Eastern Time working hours. Because Stayd runs shared systems across every brand, a process you improve here tends to end up running in six other markets, which is the closest thing we have to a promotion path.
What you’ll own
- Follow up with cleaners on turn status, ETAs and anything blocking completion.
- Coordinate re-cleans, missed items and supply fixes.
- Confirm guest-ready status for every same-day arrival.
- Assess how late checkouts affect the cleaning schedule and communicate realistic timelines.
- Relay delays, updates and completion details to Haven operations, escalating urgent issues promptly.
- Collect and post completion evidence, including photos where required.
- Keep communication with cleaners, internal teams and stakeholders clear and organized.
- Spot recurring issues and help improve cleaning workflows and SOPs.
What you bring
- Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality, housekeeping coordination or field operations is strongly preferred.
- High responsiveness and the ability to manage urgent, same-day issues without losing track of the rest.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Comfort following up with field teams, again and again, until the job is done.
- Clear written English for communication with cleaners and the operations team.
- Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours, plus occasional weekend coverage.
- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work.
Compensation & Benefits
- $1,200–$1,500/month, depending on experience.
- Fully remote, with flexible scheduling within U.S. time-zone overlap.
- A path to grow into a broader operations leadership role across the portfolio.
How to apply
Apply here in about four minutes on a phone. There are a handful of questions written to find out what you can actually do, a resume, and a short voice introduction for roles where spoken English is part of the work. There is no cover letter and there is no portal account to create.
You can listen to your recording and try again as many times as you need. If a microphone, privacy, or accessibility issue prevents recording, request another screening option and a recruiter will see it.
Every single applicant hears back from us, including a no. If we are not moving forward we will tell you, and we will tell you why. If you need an accommodation to complete this application, email careers@stayd.co. Asking never counts against you.
By applying, you agree that Stayd may contact you about your application by email and WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to opt out.

jobs.title: Workplace Operations Coordinator
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Gli spazi in cui lavoriamo contano: sono il posto dove le persone si incontrano, si aiutano e costruiscono Octopus ogni giorno. E in Italia stiamo crescendo in fretta, tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma.

Cerchiamo una persona che si prenda la responsabilità di tutti i nostri spazi fisici, con una visione d’insieme: dove abbiamo sede, a quali condizioni, con quali fornitori, se rispettiamo le norme e come cresceremo. La gestione quotidiana degli uffici è ad oggi affidata agli Office Manager, e tu li guidi e li metti nelle condizioni di lavorare bene, senza sostituirti a loro.

Non cerchiamo un facility manager e nemmeno qualcuno che aggiunga procedure. Cerchiamo una persona che tratti i nostri spazi come se fossero casa sua: con cura, con attenzione a come si spendono i soldi, e con la libertà di decidere da sola ciò che serve, senza aspettare che qualcuno lo chieda. Qualcuno con iniziativa, buonsenso e un approccio commerciale, che renda i nostri spazi semplici da vivere e sostenibili nel tempo.

-
Guida degli Office Manager: dare indirizzo e supporto agli Office Manager delle nostre sedi, definire insieme standard comuni, e fare da riferimento quando un problema supera l’operatività quotidiana.

-
Strategia degli spazi e nuove sedi: guidare la ricerca di nuove sedi e coordinare allestimenti, trasferimenti e apertura dei nuovi spazi, dal progetto alla consegna, definendo come i nostri uffici devono crescere insieme all’azienda.

-
Contratti di locazione e proprietà: gestire i contratti esistenti, le scadenze e i rinnovi, e condurre le trattative su nuovi immobili e condizioni.

-
Contratti con i fornitori: negoziare, rivedere e armonizzare i contratti quadro (pulizie, manutenzioni, utenze, sicurezza, servizi generali), cercando efficienze e sinergie tra le sedi dove ha senso.

-
Spedizioni e corrieri: governare il processo di spedizioni e posta e gestire il rapporto con il fornitore di corriere, definendo regole, livelli di servizio e costi.

-
Presidio degli asset aziendali: assicurare che gli asset di Octopus, come il magazzino e i mezzi aziendali, siano gestiti con cura (inventario, accessi, sicurezza, assicurazioni).

-
Lavorare con tutta l’azienda: collaborare con i colleghi e i responsabili delle diverse aree per far funzionare gli spazi in modo coordinato.

-
Portare avanti la missione di Octopus: fare tua la missione e l’indirizzo dell’azienda, tradurli nelle scelte sugli spazi e portarli avanti con convinzione, facendoli rispettare. Non tutto avrà una procedura già pronta: ti muovi anche dove le cose non sono definite e trovi la soluzione sensata

-
Orientamento alla soluzione e concretezza: non hai paura di metterti in gioco in prima persona, ti piace l'operatività e trovi soddisfazione nel risolvere i problemi sul campo in modo rapido e pratico.

-
Esperienza: hai avuto esperienza in contesti operativi, di accoglienza, retail, hospitality o supporto organizzativo, ma soprattutto hai una gran voglia di imparare e crescere in un contesto veloce.

-
Energia e spirito di iniziativa: sei una persona dinamica, solare e positiva. Se c'è da spostare uno scatolone, riordinare una sala o gestire un'emergenza dell'ultimo minuto, sei il* prim* a dare una mano.

-
Precisione e doti organizzative: anche nel caos saprai prioritizzare le urgenze e tenere tutto sotto controllo senza perdere il filo.

-
Condivisione della missione: senti tua la direzione dell’azienda, la traduci in decisioni concrete e la porti avanti con convinzione, facendola rispettare.

-
Comfort con il non strutturato: ti trovi a tuo agio dove non tutto è definito da procedure e sai costruire l’ordine man mano.

In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati.

Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

- Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

-
Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

-
Sede: Ancarano (TE)

-
Ore: Tempo pieno

-
Presenza in ufficio: Si

RAL a partire da 37.000 €

La normativa ci chiede di indicare la retribuzione di partenza, e ci sembra giusto farlo. Allo stesso tempo, non amiamo la burocrazia né crediamo che il valore di una persona possa essere racchiuso in una tabella. Preferiamo usare il buonsenso: l'eventuale offerta sarà costruita sulla base delle valutazioni fatte durante il percorso di selezione, tenendo conto di esperienza, competenze, luogo di lavoro e allineamento con il ruolo e con ciò che stiamo costruendo.

jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

This is a highly hands-on Paid Media role. You will work directly inside the advertising platforms every day—building and launching campaigns, uploading creatives and copy, checking tracking, monitoring performance, and making optimizations.
This is not a strategy-only, coordination, or people-management position. We’re looking for someone who enjoys executing the work themselves and taking direct ownership of campaigns from setup through ongoing optimization.
You’ll manage campaigns across multiple platforms and markets while using AI as a core part of your workflow. You’ll be operating within one of Latin America’s fastest-growing companies, as ranked by the Financial Times, on a team that is actively building AI-native workflows into everything we do.
Your work will directly impact how Clara grows across Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia—and you’ll help define what AI-augmented Paid Media execution looks like at scale

Your responsibilities will include:

- Launch, monitor and quality assurance of campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other platforms.

- Set up tracking and attribution according to internal guidelines — including AI-assisted tagging validation and anomaly detection.

- Use AI tools daily to accelerate campaign work: generating ad copy variants, summarizing performance data, building audience hypotheses, and drafting creative briefs.

- Conduct keyword and audience research using both native platform tools and AI-powered research assistants (e.g. Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, custom GPTs).

- Support in A/B tests and make regular optimizations — using AI to generate hypotheses, interpret results, and suggest next steps.

- Build and maintain recurring performance reports, leveraging AI to surface insights and write narrative summaries.

- Use automation tools (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier) to reduce repetitive manual work and create scalable workflows around campaign management.

- Work closely with the Growth Team and support teams — using AI to speed up collaboration, from briefing creative to aligning on copy.

Who you are:

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves:

- 2+ year of experience managing campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads (other platforms are a plus, but not required).

- Knows how to navigate ad platforms, create audiences, choose formats, and optimize campaigns.

- Confident working with data and tracking the main Paid Media KPIs (spreadsheets, Looker Studio, Power BI, platform native reporting tools or similar).

- Active, daily user of AI tools — you use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or similar tools as part of your real workflow, not just occasionally.

- Can write effective prompts: you know how to give AI models context, constraints and examples to get useful outputs on the first or second try.

- Has experience using AI to produce or improve ad copy, creative briefs, keyword lists, or performance summaries.

- Organized, precise and able to handle multiple campaigns in parallel.

- Comfortable communicating with both technical and non-technical teams.

- Genuinely interested in Paid Media and willing to go deep.

Nice to haves:

- Experience with automation tools like n8n, Make or Zapier to build workflows around paid media tasks.

- Experience building custom GPTs, AI agents, or AI-assisted reporting pipelines.

- Experience with less common platforms (Spotify Ads, programmatic, Uber Ads etc.).

- Interest or experience in AI workflows, internal tooling, or prompt engineering.

- Experience collaborating with creative teams — including using AI to brief or iterate on creative assets.

- Experience working with B2B SaaS or Fintech.

- Experience with MMMs and/or advanced attribution models.

- Basic understanding of landing page CRO, Google Analytics, or CRM tools like HubSpot.

Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, GA

URL: https://paidadscoaching.com/

The Paid Ads Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of Paid Ads Academy's own paid media, the campaigns that drive traffic and leads into our challenges, masterclasses, and evergreen funnels. You take the targeting, budget, and testing plan the Senior Paid Ads Coach sets and run it: building campaigns, watching spend daily, and reporting on what is working across multiple platforms: Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok, etc.

The Senior Paid Ads Coach owns strategy, budget authority, and the performance thresholds. You own execution: the builds, the daily optimizations inside those thresholds, the tracking hygiene, and the reporting that tells everyone the truth about what happened. A strategy is only as good as the account it runs in.

What makes this different from an agency seat is whose money it is. This is our budget, driving leads into the programs that fund the company. When cost per lead drifts, it is not a client conversation, it is our margin. We also teach paid ads for a living, which means our own accounts should be the strongest example of the work we put in front of students. You will be one of the people who makes that true.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Campaign Execution

- Campaign Build & Launch: Build and launch paid campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, Spotify, ChatGPT, and YouTube for challenges, masterclasses, and evergreen funnels, following the targeting, budget, and creative testing plan set by the Senior Paid Ads Coach

- Account Hygiene: Keep every account organized with consistent naming conventions, UTM tracking, and pixel and conversion tracking, working with Tech & Automations to keep data clean

- Campaign Audits: Run recurring audits of active accounts to catch structural, targeting, or budget inefficiencies before they compound

- Recruiting Ads: Post and manage paid recruiting ads when new roles go live

Performance Monitoring & Optimization

- Daily Monitoring: Check spend, cost per lead, cost per acquisition, and ROAS daily across all active campaigns

- Optimization: Pause, scale, or adjust campaigns against the performance thresholds the Senior Paid Ads Coach sets, without waiting to be told

- Platform Awareness: Track Meta, Google, and YouTube platform and policy changes that could affect active campaigns, and flag anything the Senior Paid Ads Coach needs to know

- Curriculum Flagging: Flag when a platform change is coming or occurs

- Early Warning: Flag underperformance or tracking issues the same day, before they burn budget

- Occasional Holiday/Weekend Coverage: During an active launch, monitor campaigns as needed during occasional holidays or weekends when the rest of the team is not working. In exchange, we’ll provide flexibility to adjust your schedule and make up that time during the week

- Industry Research: Run ongoing competitive and industry analysis to surface emerging trends, new ad formats, and growth opportunities

Reporting

- Recurring Reporting: Build and maintain the weekly and campaign-level performance reports for the Senior Paid Ads Coach and leadership

- Budget Pacing: Track spend against planned budget for every active campaign so nothing overspends or underspends without a reason

Creative Coordination

- Creative Briefs: Write the creative briefs for new ad concepts, partnering with Brand & Creative to shape assets and call out iteration opportunities as results come in

- Creative Requests: Partner with Brand & Creative and Funnels teams to get ad creative, copy, and landing pages built, tested, and refreshed on schedule

- Test Planning: Contribute ideas to the A/B testing plan for creative, audiences, and landing page experience, based on what you are seeing in the accounts

- Creative Testing: Run the creative and audience tests the Senior Paid Ads Coach prioritizes, and report back what won and why

Content Quality Support

- Curriculum Recommendations and QA: Do a first-pass review of new ad-related training material, checking for accuracy and consistency with current platform behavior and ensure what’s in the training aligns with what’s working and relevant

- Refresh Tracking: Keep a running list of course content that needs a refresh based on platform or strategy changes

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience: 2 to 4 years of hands-on paid media buying, building and managing campaigns directly in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube). Can confidently manage a 7-figure annual ad budget across multiple platforms.

- Tracking & Attribution: Comfortable with pixels, UTMs, and conversion tracking, and knows how to troubleshoot when the numbers do not add up

- Analytical: Comfortable working in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Excel, and can read a report and know what to do next, not just pull the numbers

- Detail & Organization: Manages multiple active campaigns and deadlines at once without letting tracking, optimization, or reporting standards slip

- Communication: Flags issues and opportunities early rather than waiting to be asked, and can explain what happened in a campaign in plain language.

- Fast moving: Advocates for the businesses’ best interest, including making budget decisions, optimization decisions, and creative decisions. Swiftly moves and takes action based on data and not feelings.

NICE TO HAVE

- Additional platform experience: TikTok, Reddit, Spotify, ChatGPT, LinkedIn Ads, Amazon Ads, App Ads

- Experience supporting A/B testing and optimization across audiences, creative, bidding, and landing pages

- Experience running lead-gen ads for challenges, webinars, or launches specifically

- Experience in online education, coaching, or membership businesses

- Experience working with agency partners or cross-functional teams

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Google Ads and other platform certifications

WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE

- Owns the Account: You treat ad spend like it is your own money and you do not need someone looking over your shoulder to catch a problem. When something is off, you have usually already found it and started working the fix.

- Fast and Disciplined: You move quickly on optimizations but you do not skip the reporting and tracking hygiene to get there. Speed that breaks attribution is not speed, because nobody can tell what worked afterward.

- Initiates: You see a trend or a problem before anyone points it out, and you act on it. You read the platform release notes, you notice a format change before it shows up in your results, and you have a point of view about what to do with it.

- Comfortable Inside a Lane: Strategy, budget authority, and the performance thresholds sit with the Senior Paid Ads Coach. You can run hard inside those thresholds without either overstepping them or waiting to be told what to do next.

- Bothered by Bad Data: An untagged campaign, a broken pixel, or a number that does not reconcile sits with you until it is resolved. You would rather stop and get it right than publish a report you do not fully trust.

- Plain-Spoken About Performance: You can explain what happened in an account to someone who does not buy media, without hiding a bad week behind jargon. Good news and bad news travel at the same speed.

EMPLOYMENT TYPE & OUTSIDE WORK

This is a full-time role, and we're looking for people who are all in. That means this is the work, not one of a few things you're juggling.

To protect focus and prevent burnout, we don't permit outside work or side gigs for full-time team members. If you currently run a business or have a commitment you're not looking to step away from, this likely isn't the right fit, and that's okay. We'd rather be upfront so we're aligned from the start.

We've found the people who thrive here are the ones whose energy and vision are fully on this business. That focus is what helps the whole team win.

Please note: applicants must reside within the US to be considered.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Base Salary: $65,000-$75,000 per year, depending on experience

- Flexible PTO: Flexible time off after 6 months, plus company-wide holidays

- Retirement Plan: 401(k) with employer match after 6 months

- Profit-Sharing 401(k): Employer-funded contributions based on tenure and other plan factors, with a 3-year vesting schedule

- Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks fully paid to the primary provider and 4 weeks fully paid to the secondary provider (eligibility based on length of service)

- Wardrobe Stipend: $2,000 first-year bonus for business attire

- Home Office Stipend: $500 to create a productive remote workspace

- Annual Incentive Trip: Fully-paid team trip to a bucket-list destination

- Wellness Benefit: Georgia-based employees receive monthly access to our private Wellness Center (gym, sauna, and cold plunge). Employees outside Georgia receive a monthly wellness stipend (up to $50 per month) through reimbursement.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/paid-ads-academy-paid-ads-specialist

jobs.title: IT Support Specialist - APAC
jobs.summary: Smartly is looking for a proactive and customer-focused IT Support Specialist to join our Global IT team and help strengthen technical support across the APAC region.
jobs.description:
Smartly is looking for a proactive and customer-focused IT Support Specialist to join our Global IT team and help strengthen technical support across the APAC region.

In this role, you will provide hands-on and remote technical support to employees across multiple locations, troubleshooting hardware, software, identity and access, and connectivity issues. You will primarily support macOS and Windows environments while working with enterprise applications, device management platforms, and cloud-based technologies.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, takes ownership of their work, and can operate independently while collaborating with a globally distributed team.

This position plays an important role in expanding our early-morning APAC support coverage, particularly for employees in Australia, Singapore, the Philippines, India, and China.

As an IT Support Specialist, You Will:

- Provide Regional IT Support: Deliver timely and reliable technical assistance across APAC, with a focus on early business hours in Australia and Southeast Asia.

- Troubleshoot Technical Issues: Diagnose and resolve macOS, Windows, mobile device, hardware, software, networking, and application-related issues.

- Own Support Requests: Manage IT tickets from initial investigation through resolution, ensuring proper prioritization, documentation, communication, and follow-through.

- Support Employee Onboarding and Offboarding: Coordinate device provisioning, account creation, access management, and equipment returns.

- Manage Enterprise IT Systems: Assist with Google Workspace, identity and access management, endpoint management, and other internal IT platforms.

- Support Regional Offices and Leadership: Provide professional and responsive IT assistance to employees, Workplace teams, and regional leadership.

- Collaborate Globally: Work with IT colleagues across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas to ensure effective communication, escalation, and handovers.

- Improve IT Processes: Maintain documentation, contribute to our knowledge base, identify recurring issues, and recommend improvements to support workflows.

- Take Initiative and Ownership: Independently investigate and resolve technical issues, proactively communicate blockers, and escalate complex situations when appropriate.

We're Definitely Looking for You If You Have:

- 3+ years of relevant experience in IT Support, Service Desk, or IT Operations.

- Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience with macOS and Windows in a corporate environment.

- Experience with enterprise identity and access management, including user provisioning, SSO, MFA, and account permissions.

- Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or similar enterprise administration platforms.

- Experience using IT ticketing systems, managing competing priorities, and following issues through to resolution.

- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.

- Familiarity with endpoint management, device security, and basic IT compliance practices.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and a strong customer-service mindset.

- Ability to work independently, troubleshoot unfamiliar problems, and make sound decisions with limited supervision.

- Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to communication.

- Ability to work the designated early APAC shift and collaborate effectively with colleagues across global time zones.

It's a Plus If You Have:

- Experience with MDM solutions such as Jamf, Kandji/Iru, Microsoft Intune, or Workspace ONE.

- Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace.

- Experience supporting Apple devices in a predominantly macOS environment.

- Familiarity with Slack administration and enterprise SaaS applications.

- Experience with IT automation or scripting using Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies.

- Experience supporting iOS and Android devices in a corporate environment.

- Experience providing IT support to senior executives.

- Experience supporting distributed offices or working within a global IT team.

- Familiarity with ITIL principles and IT service management best practices.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on how IT services are delivered across our APAC region.

As part of a global IT team, you'll gain exposure to a broad range of enterprise technologies, collaborate with colleagues around the world, and contribute to improving our processes and employee experience.

We value curiosity, initiative, accountability, and continuous learning. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to grow beyond traditional service desk responsibilities, take ownership of meaningful challenges, and help shape a reliable and scalable IT support environment.

Apply Now and Shape Your Future with Smartly!
About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

jobs.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

This is a key role in the Financial Control team. We are responsible for the month-end close, the preparation of financial accounts, and play a key role in delivering audits. Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will be an Assistant Management Accountant with experience delivering month-end activities and performing P&L and balance sheet reconciliations.

What excites you

Ownership:

- Own the preparation and posting of monthly journals such as accruals, prepayments and adjustments across all entities.

- Own key balance sheet accounts across the group, completing monthly reconciliations and resolving variances in a timely, documented manner

Collaboration:

- Work closely with teams across the business, including AP, Tax and Management Reporting

- Supporting the Finance Manager when required

- Assist with the annual audits in preparation and provide the requested documents

Analysis:

- Produce P&L variance analysis and commentary

What must you have

- Experience in a financial control or management accounting environment

- Use Excel or Google Sheets with confidence

- Show attention to detail

- Be a team player, with ability to work independently

What might you have

- Perform multi-currency balance sheet reconciliations, ideally across multiple entities

- Familiar with NetSuite and FloQast apps

- Communicate confidently with internationally based stakeholders

- Hold an accounting qualification

- Use AI to identify process efficiencies

- Ability to prioritise time and stay organised in a fast-paced environment

Base salary range: € 25,600- € 38,400 (gross), (including 13th and 14th salary).

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point (€ 25,600 - € 32,000) of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.
(some of) The good stuff

- Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover

- Lunch- based on the location, you either get a meal voucher or a paid lunch when working from the office

- Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 20 working days in any 12-month period

- Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle

- Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure

- Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget

- Time off - generous holiday allowance + volunteer days for ERG events + one day off if you need to move house

Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.

Diversity & Inclusion

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:

Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — 25%

Neurodiverse — 9%

LGBTQIA+ — 9%

Disabled — 1%

Average age — 33

Female — 45%

Male — 55%

We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.

If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives here

Sustainability

We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability action plan here.

Find out more about Life at GoCardless via Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Specialist - Hybrid
jobs.summary: Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation.
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

Product Marketing Specialist, Brasil

Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs, in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. Join us if you want a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career, alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you'll do

You'll own product marketing execution for Brazil: messaging, launches, sales enablement, and content that turns product capability into a story the Brazilian market believes. You'll work closely with the Head of Product Marketing & GTM, LatAm, and use AI to produce at a pace a small team shouldn't be able to match.

Your responsibilities

- Localize and adapt global positioning and messaging for Brazil, accounting for local market dynamics, competitors, and buyer language, not just translation.

- Execute go-to-market for product launches and features in Brazil: enablement materials, customer communications, and launch content.

- Build and maintain sales enablement assets: battlecards, FAQs, objection handling, and competitive comparisons for the Brazilian sales team.

- Use AI Building processes daily to accelerate production: drafting content, generating messaging variants, researching competitors, and turning briefs into usable assets quickly.

- Track and report on the metrics that show whether messaging and launches are working: activation, win rates, sales feedback, and content performance.

- Partner with Growth Marketing and Sales in Brazil to keep narrative and campaigns aligned with what's actually happening in the market.

- Monitor Brazilian fintech competitors and feed intelligence back into positioning and enablement.

Must haves

- 2-4 years in product marketing, growth marketing, or a closely related function.

- Strong storyteller: writing samples or work you can point to that turned a product fact into a clear, persuasive narrative.

- Analytical: comfortable working with data to judge whether messaging or a launch actually worked.

- Active, daily use of AI Building tools as part of your real workflow.

- Native or fluent Portuguese, strong written and spoken English.

- Based in Brasil, with a working understanding of the Brazilian B2B buyer and competitive landscape.

- Organized and able to execute independently once direction is set.

Nice to haves

- Fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS experience.

- Startup experience, where you've had to move fast with limited resources.

- Experience building AI-assisted research, content, or enablement workflows.

- Experience working with global or distributed marketing teams.

Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites.
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

- Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands

- Skincare and beauty

- Tech and software

- Finance and investing

- Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability

- Education

- Home improvement

- Automobiles and motorcycles

- Health and wellness

- Medical and clinical fields

- Digital marketing

- SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities

- Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites

- Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy

- Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors

- Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices

- Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing

- Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications

- Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills

- 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred

- Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices

- Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics

- Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content

- Portfolio featuring published work preferred

- Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Job Title: People Operations Coordinator - Temp to FTE Opportunity, 3 month contract

Job Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

- Lifecycle Administration. Manages the employee lifecycle for the assigned business function, from offer through exit. Prepares offer letters, coordinates background checks and I-9 and right-to-work verification, and runs onboarding and offboarding, including exit surveys, so every transition is accurate and on time.

- Employee Data & Records. Maintains accurate employee data in HiBob and ADP for the assigned business function. Processes hires, changes, promotions, transfers, terminations, and org updates, and audits records and personnel files to keep data clean and audit-ready.

- HR Case Management. Serves as the first point of contact for employee and manager questions through people@ and HappyFox. Resolves routine requests promptly and escalates complex or sensitive issues to People Business Partners and specialists.

- Mobility, & Benefits Support. Serves as the first point of contact for benefits questions and partners closely with the Benefits and Mobility Specialist to keep PBPs informed on mobility cases.

- PBP, ER & Programs Support.
